title: Red flags in options marketing: guaranteed income and huge returns
summary: The speaker lists claims that should make you run: guaranteed or easy income, quit your nine-to-five, never buy options only sell options, I turned six dollars into millions, or $5,000 a week. Managing money and trading options is hard, part art and part science. The clip also promotes his upcoming Discord and software tools.

params.label: Excess drift over rate
params.help: Your view of annual return above the risk-free rate. Zero = the market view; EV is then about zero.

steps.caption: Illustration: the 'only sell options' trade, a 30-day put sold at $95 on a $100 stock.
The stock can land anywhere in this range by expiry. Nothing about it is guaranteed.
Large moves are less likely but real; they are what 'easy income' leaves out.
Below the breakeven the premium is gone and the trade loses money.
Probability of profit is below 100%: option income is not guaranteed.

takeaways: Run if someone promises guaranteed or easy income, or says to quit your nine-to-five.
'Never buy options, only sell options' is a red flag.
Claims like turning six dollars into millions or $5,000 a week are red flags too.
Managing money and trading options is hard; it is both an art and a science.
caveats: The short put example and probability chart are added illustration; the speaker only lists the red flags.
The clip promotes the speaker's upcoming Discord and software tools, which are not verified here.
